# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Type Mismatch (Date/Time) | 416-15 | Agent writes formatted strings instead of `datetime` objects. | OUTPUT-CONTRACT | CONTRACT |
| 2 | Unnecessary Modification | 38462, 39046, 50768, 560-12 | Agent overwrites cells that should have remained untouched or wrote values that matched the input. | BEHAVIORAL | STRUCTURE (Checklist) |
| 3 | Range/Boundary Error | 560-12, 50768, 43436, 227-40 | Agent wrote outside target range or missed cells within it. | OUTPUT-CONTRACT | CONTRACT |
| 4 | Logic/Calculation Error | 51-12, 39046, 43436 | Incorrect Python implementation of task logic. | CAPABILITY-GAP | METHOD |
| 5 | Format/Precision Miss | 267-18, 560-12 | Incorrect string prefix or formatting. | OUTPUT-CONTRACT | CONTRACT |

## Changes made this iteration (one row per edit — aim for MULTIPLE classes, incl. a NEW tool when a cluster needs one)
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Type Mismatch (Date/Time) | CONTRACT | guidance.md | Explicitly require `datetime.date` or `datetime.datetime` objects for dates/times to ensure correct Excel typing. | Yes, passing tasks that write dates already use these or don't write dates. |
| Unnecessary Modification | STRUCTURE | guidance.md | Moved "PRESERVE INPUTS" to the final verification checklist to make it an explicit, unavoidable step. | Yes, all passing tasks already preserve inputs. |
| Range/Boundary Error | CONTRACT | prompt.md | Added instruction to explicitly calculate and strictly adhere to the coordinates of `answer_position` during execution. | Yes, passing tasks already adhere to boundaries. |

## Verify-the-fix (one line per change: the trace it targets → what the guard/computation/new-tool now does on those exact inputs)
- 416-15: wrote strings like "2021-04-21" $\rightarrow$ will now use `datetime` objects.
- 38462, 39046, 50768: modified cells that should have been untouched $\rightarrow$ will now check this against original values in the final checklist.
- 560-12, 50768: wrote past the target range $\rightarrow$ will now calculate boundaries first.

## Process & features used
- Serial execution for diagnosis and drafting.
- Used `bash` for trajectory analysis and clustering.

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- The strict "Literals Only" contract (No Formulas).
- The "Type Fidelity" rules for numbers and text.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why — already-passing / needs gold / infra noise)
- Logic/Calculation Error: These are often task-specific; focusing on systemic issues first.
